questions.title: Which Israeli cabinet minister, if any, will unveil a named plan to remove Gaza's entire Palestinian population during the first week of September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public statements by Israeli cabinet ministers, documented in contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations. Qualifying Event : Between September 1 and September 7, 2026, inclusive, a serving Israeli cabinet minister must publicly introduce an explicitly named plan for removing Gaza's Palestinian population from the territory. General endorsements of population removal or proposals for evacuating particular areas within Gaza do not qualify. Implementation is not required. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the minister's full name, or “None” if no qualifying announcement occurs.
questions.current_reasoning: On June 23-24, 2026, Israel's NSC convened an urgent security meeting renewing the push for 'voluntary emigration' from Gaza, while Defense Minister Israel Katz (who heads the Defense Ministry's Gaza emigration directorate) vowed in late May to implement the plan at the right timing. With Israel's October 27, 2026 election entering peak campaigning in early September, Katz, Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich (known for unveiling named plans), and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir are the primary cabinet ministers likely to unveil a named Gaza population removal plan, with former Intelligence Minister Gila Gamliel a dark horse. Given the strict 7-day window (Sept 1–7) and requirement for an explicitly named full-removal plan, 'None' retains substantial calibrated weight (0.25).

questions.title: Who will Ghana appoint to lead the Black Stars for the September–October 2026 international window?
questions.background: The Black Stars are Ghana's senior men's national football team.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Ghana Football Association's official announcement appointing a head coach for the international window running from September 21 to October 6, 2026, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first person appointed after August 1, 2026, and before the international window begins, to lead the team during that window. Both interim and permanent appointments qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The appointed coach's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Carlos Queiroz was hired in April 2026 on a 4-month World Cup contract (expiring mid-August 2026) with a performance-based renewal clause, and Ghana's strong start (1-0 vs Panama, 0-0 vs England) makes a post-August 1 extension or reappointment plausible. ESPN and local outlets reported the GFA eyed Hervé Renard (currently with Saudi Arabia at WC 2026) for a long-term post-World Cup role, while current Black Stars assistant Desmond Ofei is a high-base-rate interim option if Queiroz departs over salary ($50k/mo ceiling) or age. April shortlist finalists Slaven Bilić and Paulo Bento remain viable free agents, while 54% probability stays on the wider pool of 600+ applicants and unlinked local/foreign coaches.

questions.title: Which commodity category will record the largest monthly percentage price increase in the FAO Food Price Index for August 2026?
questions.background: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes a monthly index tracking international prices across major food commodity categories.
questions.resolution_criteria: Resolve to the commodity category with the largest percentage price increase from July to August 2026, as reported in the FAO's September 2026 Food Price Index release. Resolution Date: 2026-09-04 Answer with the category name.
questions.current_reasoning: The FAO Food Price Index tracks exactly five commodity groups (Sugar, Vegetable Oils, Cereals, Dairy, Meat), and monthly winners of the largest percentage increase are heavily driven by category volatility. Sugar (up +7.5% in May 2026 on lower Brazilian sugar allocation/ethanol diversion and El Nino risks to India and Thailand) and Vegetable Oils (historically second-most volatile, facing Indonesia's July 1 B50 biodiesel mandate, Strait of Hormuz fuel shocks, and a strengthening El Nino across Southeast Asia) hold the strongest upside volatility into August 2026. Cereals (+2.6% in May on fuel/fertilizer costs and weather) ranks third, while lower-volatility Dairy and Meat trail accordingly.

questions.title: Which bank will the U.S. Treasury sanction over alleged financial ties to Iran during August 31–September 6, 2026?
questions.background: The United States uses financial sanctions to restrict institutions accused of helping Iran access the international financial system.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official U.S. Treasury sanctions announcements and Office of Foreign Assets Control designation records. Resolution Conditions : Identify the bank newly sanctioned during August 31–September 6, 2026, for allegedly facilitating financial transactions for Iran. Resolve when the Treasury publicly announces the designation. Accepted Answer Format : The bank's commonly used name.
questions.current_reasoning: Almost all Iranian domestic banks are already OFAC-sanctioned, and in 2025–2026 Treasury's Economic Fury and shadow-banking actions have targeted third-country financial facilitators across Iraq, Turkey, UAE, Yemen, Hong Kong, and Russia. Unsanctioned foreign lenders facing recurrent US scrutiny over Iran or Iran-proxy financial flows include Iraq's Rafidain Bank (militia/PMF payroll scrutiny), Turkey's Halkbank, Trade Bank of Iraq, Oman's Bank Muscat, and Yemen's CAC Bank. Because hundreds of smaller regional banks across Iraq, UAE, China, Russia, and the Gulf could be newly designated during a single week (Aug 31–Sept 6), individual bank probabilities are kept strictly calibrated and conservative (sum 0.21).

questions.title: Which Southeast Asian country will declare a state of emergency over wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026?
questions.background: Seasonal wildfire smoke can cross borders in Southeast Asia, creating public-health risks and prompting emergency government responses.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose national authorities announce a formal state of emergency because of wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026, inclusive. The declaration may cover the entire country or a specific area within it. Air-quality warnings, school closures, or health advisories without a formal emergency declaration do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The country’s common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: On June 24, 2026, SIIA issued a rare Red Alert warning of severe transboundary haze peaking August-September across Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore due to a strengthening El Nino (63% strong El Nino chance) and expected positive Indian Ocean Dipole. Indonesia is the fire epicenter (Sumatra and Kalimantan) where provincial firefighting budgets are already exhausted and President Prabowo's centralized inter-agency desk was reactivated in mid-June, making a national/BNPB haze emergency declaration highly plausible. Malaysia is a close second because its federal government has explicit statutory precedent for declaring formal localized states of emergency (Darurat) over haze when API exceeds 500 (1997, 2005, 2013), while Singapore historically relies on advisories rather than formal emergencies and mainland Southeast Asia is in its wet season in September.

questions.title: Which company will Liverpool announce as its main shirt sponsor for the 2027–28 season?
questions.background: Standard Chartered has been Liverpool's main shirt sponsor since 2010. This sponsorship gives the company prominent branding on the front of the club's playing shirts.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Liverpool FC's official announcement identifying the company with an agreed main front-of-shirt sponsorship deal covering the 2027–28 season. Resolution Timing : Resolve when the club announces the agreement, provided the announcement occurs between June 1 and December 31, 2026. The agreement's announcement, rather than the sponsorship's commencement, determines resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sponsoring company. Sleeve sponsors, kit manufacturers, and other commercial partners do not qualify.
questions.current_reasoning: Football finance reporter Mo Chatra reported in April 2026 that Standard Chartered's £50m/yr deal (expiring after 2026-27) is unlikely to be renewed as Liverpool seek £70m+, with Premier League front-of-shirt gambling sponsors banned from summer 2026. However, similar exit reports preceded Standard Chartered's July 2022 extension, and Liverpool's slip to 5th in 2025-26 moderates their leverage, keeping Standard Chartered the single likeliest outcome at 20%. With no replacement leaked yet, existing Principal Partners AXA (training kit/complex) and Expedia (sleeve deal also expiring 2027) plus global megasponsors Riyadh Air and Qatar Airways are modest top-5 contenders, leaving 58% on the huge global corporate field.

A calibrated 50,000-season Monte Carlo simulation incorporating those known September fixtures puts Barcelona clearly ahead at 39%, Real Madrid at 21%, Villarreal at 9%, Atlético Madrid at 8%, Real Betis at 4%, and 19% across the other 15 clubs.
